description: Explicit hierarchy of the rail sources per information category: the score of each source, the bonus when the operator of the train is the source's own, and the community feeds admitted only to cover a gap.

preferences.note: Which offline pack's copy of a train is shown (route search, journeys) is decided by PlannedPackOrder: the national packs come first there, and these scores only order the packs within its classes.
